metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness around the Blue Lagoon in Iceland on November 24, 2024, greater than the brightness over Reykjavík at 4 am local time?

data.raw_code: The question asks about nighttime brightness at two locations in Iceland on a specific date and time (Nov 24, 2024, 4am local time). Key considerations: 1. We need nighttime light data - VIIRS DNB is appropriate 2. Need to handle the specific time (4am local time) - VIIRS has specific overpass times 3. Two locations: Blue Lagoon and Reykjavík 4. Compare brightness values 5. Date is in the future relative to current time (2024) - will need to handle data availability Data selection: - Use "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V21" or "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V2" for VIIRS nighttime lights - For specific time of day, may need to use "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DNB_MONTHLY" with time filtering - Could also use "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V21" for daily data Processing: 1. Get coordinates for both locations 2. Filter collection by date (around Nov 24, 2024) 3. Check for data availability 4. Extract brightness values 5. Compare them Data availability challenge: Since Nov 24, 2024 is in the future, we need to handle the case where no data exists. We can: 1. Try the exact date 2. If no data, use historical data from same date in previous years 3. If still no data, output C1 Let me structure: 1. Define points for Blue Lagoon and Reykjavík 2. Use VIIRS DNB monthly collection for November 2024 3. Extract radiance values 4. Compare ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries const blueLagoon = ee.Geometry.Point([-22.4495, 63.8804]); // Blue Lagoon, Iceland const reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.9426, 64.1466]); // Reykjavík, Iceland // Buffer for area comparison (500m radius) const blueLagoonBuffer = blueLagoon.buffer(500); const reykjavikBuffer = reykjavik.buffer(500); // 2. Define date for November 24, 2024 const targetDate = '2024-11-24'; const startDate = ee.Date('2024-11-01'); const endDate = ee.Date('2024-12-01'); // 3. Try VIIRS DNB Monthly collection first let viirsCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V21') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('avg_rad'); // Check collection size const colSize = viirsCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Monthly VIIRS images for Nov 2024: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try daily VIIRS console.log('Trying daily VIIRS data...'); viirsCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V21') .filterDate(ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-2, 'day'), ee.Date(targetDate).advance(2, 'day')) .select('avg_rad'); const dailySize = viirsCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Daily VIIRS images around ${targetDate}: ${dailySize}`); if (dailySize === 0) { // Try historical data from same date in previous year console.log('Trying historical data (2023)...'); viirsCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V21') .filterDate('2023-11-01', '2023-12-01') .select('avg_rad'); const histSize = viirsCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Historical VIIRS images for Nov 2023: ${histSize}`); if (histSize === 0) { console.log('No VIIRS data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } } // 4. Get the image (first one in collection for monthly, median for daily) let img; if (viirsCol.size().getInfo() > 1) { img = viirsCol.median(); // For daily composite } else { img = viirsCol.first(); // For monthly data } // 5. Extract brightness values const blueLagoonStats = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: blueLagoonBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, }).getInfo(); const reykjavikStats = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: reykjavikBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, }).getInfo(); const blueLagoonBrightness = blueLagoonStats.avg_rad; const reykjavikBrightness = reykjavikStats.avg_rad; console.log(`Blue Lagoon brightness: ${blueLagoonBrightness}`); console.log(`Reykjavík brightness: ${reykjavikBrightness}`); // 6. Check for valid values if (blueLagoonBrightness === null || reykjavikBrightness === null || isNaN(blueLagoonBrightness) || isNaN(reykjavikBrightness)) { console.log('One or both values are invalid.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Compare and output answer if (blueLagoonBrightness > reykjavikBrightness) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
